hebrewText: וְ/יָשְׁב֣וּ עָלֶי/הָ֮ לָ/בֶטַח֒ וּ/בָנ֤וּ בָתִּים֙ וְ/נָטְע֣וּ כְרָמִ֔ים וְ/יָשְׁב֖וּ לָ/בֶ֑טַח בַּ/עֲשׂוֹתִ֣/י שְׁפָטִ֗ים בְּ/כֹ֨ל הַ/שָּׁאטִ֤ים אֹתָ/ם֙ מִ/סְּבִ֣יבוֹתָ֔/ם וְ/יָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶֽם

tokens.bdb: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
tokens.kjv: (make to) abide(-ing), continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-ing), ease self, endure, establish, [idiom] fail, habitation, haunt, (make to) inhabit(-ant), make to keep (house), lurking, [idiom] marry(-ing), (bring again to) place, remain, return, seat, set(-tle), (down-) sit(-down, still, -ting down, -ting (place) -uate), take, tarry.

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

tokens.bdb: properly, a place of refuge; abstract, safety, both the fact (security) and the feeling (trust); often (adverb with or without preposition) safely
tokens.kjv: assurance, boldly, (without) care(-less), confidence, hope, safe(-ly, -ty), secure, surely.

tokens.bdb: to build (literally and figuratively)
tokens.kjv: (begin to) build(-er), obtain children, make, repair, set (up), [idiom] surely.

tokens.bdb: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
tokens.kjv: court, daughter, door, [phrase] dungeon, family, [phrase] forth of, [idiom] great as would contain, hangings, home(born), (winter) house(-hold), inside(-ward), palace, place, [phrase] prison, [phrase] steward, [phrase] tablet, temple, web, [phrase] within(-out).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a house (in the greatest variation of applications
tokens.enLiteralWord: a house (in the greatest variation of applications
tokens.explanation: a house (in the greatest variation of applications
tokens.explanationEn: a house (in the greatest variation of applications

tokens.bdb: properly, to strike in, i.e. fix; specifically, to plant (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: fastened, plant(-er).

tokens.bdb: a garden or vineyard
tokens.kjv: vines, (increase of the) vineyard(-s), vintage. See also H1021 (בֵּית הַכֶּרֶם).

tokens.bdb: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
tokens.kjv: (make to) abide(-ing), continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-ing), ease self, endure, establish, [idiom] fail, habitation, haunt, (make to) inhabit(-ant), make to keep (house), lurking, [idiom] marry(-ing), (bring again to) place, remain, return, seat, set(-tle), (down-) sit(-down, still, -ting down, -ting (place) -uate), take, tarry.

tokens.bdb: properly, a place of refuge; abstract, safety, both the fact (security) and the feeling (trust); often (adverb with or without preposition) safely
tokens.kjv: assurance, boldly, (without) care(-less), confidence, hope, safe(-ly, -ty), secure, surely.

tokens.bdb: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
tokens.kjv: accomplish, advance, appoint, apt, be at, become, bear, bestow, bring forth, bruise, be busy, [idiom] certainly, have the charge of, commit, deal (with), deck, [phrase] displease, do, (ready) dress(-ed), (put in) execute(-ion), exercise, fashion, [phrase] feast, (fight-) ing man, [phrase] finish, fit, fly, follow, fulfill, furnish, gather, get, go about, govern, grant, great, [phrase] hinder, hold (a feast), [idiom] indeed, [phrase] be industrious, [phrase] journey, keep, labour, maintain, make, be meet, observe, be occupied, offer, [phrase] officer, pare, bring (come) to pass, perform, pracise, prepare, procure, provide, put, requite, [idiom] sacrifice, serve, set, shew, [idiom] sin, spend, [idiom] surely, take, [idiom] thoroughly, trim, [idiom] very, [phrase] vex, be (warr-) ior, work(-man), yield, use.

tokens.bdb: a sentence, i.e. infliction
tokens.kjv: judgment.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

tokens.bdb: one contemning
tokens.kjv: that (which) despise(-d).

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).

tokens.bdb: (as noun) a circle, neighbour, or environs; but chiefly (as adverb, with or without preposition) around
tokens.kjv: (place, round) about, circuit, compass, on every side.

tokens.bdb: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
tokens.kjv: acknowledge, acquaintance(-ted with), advise, answer, appoint, assuredly, be aware, (un-) awares, can(-not), certainly, comprehend, consider, [idiom] could they, cunning, declare, be diligent, (can, cause to) discern, discover, endued with, familiar friend, famous, feel, can have, be (ig-) norant, instruct, kinsfolk, kinsman, (cause to let, make) know, (come to give, have, take) knowledge, have (knowledge), (be, make, make to be, make self) known, [phrase] be learned, [phrase] lie by man, mark, perceive, privy to, [idiom] prognosticator, regard, have respect, skilful, shew, can (man of) skill, be sure, of a surety, teach, (can) tell, understand, have (understanding), [idiom] will be, wist, wit, wot.

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.enLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanation: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanationEn: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed

tokens.bdb: I
tokens.kjv: I, (as for) me, mine, myself, we, [idiom] which, [idiom] who.

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).

tokens.bdb: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
tokens.kjv: angels, [idiom] exceeding, God (gods) (-dess, -ly), [idiom] (very) great, judges, [idiom] mighty.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus
tokens.enLiteralWord: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus
tokens.explanation: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus
tokens.explanationEn: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus
